integrity: The six scientific files and standalone verifier are complete. Counting conventions and range restrictions are stated explicitly. All quoted older results are attributed; no independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Complete enumerator is a transfer identity in terms of E_G(q) and O_G(q), not a closed formula for arbitrary base graphs. Full general proof is symbolic; small cases are checked directly. Terminology is induced-odd vertex partitions, distinct from proper neighborhood-parity odd coloring. Literature comparisons cannot eliminate unindexed work.
title: The parity-switch enumerator for induced-odd colorings of clique coronas
